cases.question: Compare Alpha care with usual care. What were the absolute and relative reductions in median delivery time, using usual care as the baseline?
cases.expected_answer: The absolute reduction was 6 minutes. The relative reduction was 25% (6/24).

human_review.note: 18/24 分钟、绝对差 6 分钟和相对差 25% 均正确；把 medicine delivery 语境中的 delivery 译作“分娩”，改变了指标含义。引用有效，自动支持审查未发现此语义错误。

cases.answer: Alpha care 的中位分娩时间为 18 分钟（IQR 12-24）。 常规护理的中位分娩时间为 24 分钟（IQR 16-30）。 以常规护理为基线，Alpha care 相比常规护理的中位分娩时间绝对减少为 24 − 18 = 6 分钟。 以常规护理为基线，Alpha care 相比常规护理的中位分娩时间相对减少为 (24 − 18) / 24 = 25%。

cases.question: Compare the enrollment totals and per-arm allocations in Studies Alpha and Beta.
cases.expected_answer: Alpha enrolled 120 adults, 60 per arm. Beta enrolled 80 adults, 40 per arm.

human_review.note: 两项研究的样本量、分组人数及差值均符合合成原文；所有引文有效。

cases.answer: Study Alpha enrolled 120 adults. Study Beta enrolled 80 adults. Study Alpha enrolled 40 more adults than Study Beta (120 − 80 = 40). Study Alpha allocated 60 participants to Alpha care and 60 to usual care. Study Beta allocated 40 participants to Beta care and 40 to usual care. Each arm in Study Alpha had 20 more participants than the corresponding arm in Study Beta (60 − 40 = 20).
